text:
alex: Quick heads-up — ran the docs linter across the runtime guides, found ~12 broken anchors and 3 images returning 403. I'm opening a single PR with the fixes, but need owners to sanity-check before merge.

maya: thanks alex — can you drop the PR link here?

alex: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4821. Main fixes: anchor normalization, a tiny redirect, and two image rehosts.

sam: I can take the S3 rehosts for the three images. @rachel do you own the runtime/compilation page mentioned in the report?

rachel: yep — that's on me. i'll check the anchors and push a tiny sed-based patch in the PR.

alex: sed snippet I used for most anchors: ```sed -E 's#\]\(\/docs\/runtime#](\/docs\/runtime\/)#g' -i``` (covers trailing slash normalization)

docs-bot: automated link-scan report uploaded: summary.csv (see PR). :rotating_light:

maya: small ask — for minor link fixes can reviewers skip full E2E runs? saves CI time for doc-only changes.

sam: +1 to skipping full E2E for pure docs changes. Suggest label docs:minor and auto-merge on green unit checks.

alex: sounds good. i'll tag the PR with docs:chore and set reviewers to docs-owners; enable auto-merge for green checks.

rachel: one caveat — there's one anchor that 404s due to a slug rename from a couple weeks ago. i'll open a redirect PR to preserve old links.

maya: great — moving this into the docs sweep sprint. assigned to @rachel (anchors/redirect) and @sam (images). i'll monitor merge.

alex: thanks team :thumbsup: i'll add a blurb to the next release notes about minor link fixes and the redirect we'll keep for 90 days.

(attachments: link-scan summary.csv, PR #4821)
